description:
DB backup job cannot start if PostgreSQL is connected via DB_URL for Unix domain socket usage

https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/4609adbb6d8c25650e75df8e6759986ec26f7d3b/server/src/services/database-backup.service.ts#L217 throws a `TypeError` exception if URL "hostname" is path

1. Share PostgreSQL with Immich via UDS using DB_URL environment variable in the format like `socket://user:password@/path/to/postgres/socket?db=immich`
2. Wait for backup job to fire.

tests_added: database-backup.service.spec.ts: should fallback to reasonable defaults

evidence: test: database-backup.service.spec.ts: should fallback to reasonable defaults

notes: Issue with TypeError location and UDS DB_URL repro; per policy 2 this is symptom evidence, not mechanism (the issue links the line but does not state the fix). Fix computes databasePassword in the parsed-URL branch of buildPostgresLaunchArguments; RC exact; boundary job (backup job, database-backup.service.ts:231).

tests: database-backup.service.spec.ts: DatabaseBackupService buildPostgresLaunchArguments using an unparsable URL should fallback to reasonable defaults
